summary: Preserved candidate PR 2113's N=16 specialization, input validation, and bounded no-copy-engine fallback, then corrected the counterexample found by PR 2218 by chunking arbitrary positive vectors into bounded 512-element by-value launches. The exact candidate rejected N=513 and N=1024; the corrected rebuilt library copied N=513, N=1024, and independent N=1025 exactly.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate 3ac707e, rebuilt the checked-out native source for gfx950. Exact copies passed through N=512, while N=513, N=1024, and N=1025 were rejected with the 512-element cap. See evidence/candidate-native-probe.log.

Rebuilt the corrected native source for gfx950 and compared GPU output exactly with CPU int32 references. All tested N=1..1025 boundary cases passed, specifically N=512, N=513, N=1024, and N=1025. See evidence/corrected-native-probe.log.
The consolidated patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution_evidence: Freshly rebuilt native extensions ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- GPU. Results were compared against independently constructed CPU int32 vectors with rtol=0 and atol=0.
native_rebuild_evidence: Both exact candidate and corrected copy.cu sources were HIP-translated with zero unsupported CUDA calls and compiled separately with /opt/rocm-7.2.4/bin/hipcc --offload-arch=gfx950, then loaded directly instead of using the installed wheel.
remaining_limitations: The original GLM-5.2 weights and two-node TP16/EP16 DeepEP environment were unavailable, so full serving was not reproduced.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2 was assigned; NVIDIA H800/CUDA compilation and execution remain unverified.
The prepared ROCm sgl_kernel package does not register copy_to_gpu_no_ce, so focused extensions were rebuilt from checked-out source.
Model semantic accuracy and distributed routing remain outside what this native transfer fixture establishes.
